description: Runs rule-based heuristic analysis for potential mix issues: frequency buildup, dynamics problems, routing inefficiencies, headroom. Only call when the user explicitly asks for mix feedback or describes a specific problem — do NOT call proactively. Findings are suggestions to consider, not problems to fix. Mix quality is subjective — frame results in context of what the user is trying to achieve. A technically 'imperfect' setting may be an intentional artistic choice.
name: analyze_mix
